description: Defines the HpackFuzzUtil class and related structures for fuzz testing HPACK header compression in SPDY/HTTP2, including header generation, input management, and fuzzing stages.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil
classes.description: Utility class for fuzz testing HPACK header compression, including header generation, input handling, and fuzzing stages.

classes.name: GeneratorContext
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct holding ordered header names and values for header set generation.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct managing an input string and current offset for parsing header blocks.

classes.name: FuzzerContext
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct holding decoder and encoder stages for fuzzing header blocks.

methods.name: InitializeGeneratorContext
methods.description: Initializes a GeneratorContext with a random seed and header name/value fixtures.

methods.name: NextGeneratedHeaderSet
methods.description: Generates a header set from the generator context.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a size from an exponential distribution with a specified mean, bounded by a sanity limit.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Constructor for Input struct, initializes offset to zero.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining bytes in the input string.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current position in the input string.

methods.name: NextHeaderBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the next header block from input, if available.

methods.name: HeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the serialized length prefix for a header block of given size.

methods.name: InitializeFuzzerContext
methods.description: Initializes a FuzzerContext with decoder and encoder stages.

methods.name: RunHeaderBlockThroughFuzzerStages
methods.description: Processes an input block through the fuzzing stages, returning success status.

methods.name: FlipBits
methods.description: Randomly flips bits in a buffer based on specified flip rate.
